metadata.title: Pakistan Constituent Casework Taxonomy
metadata.description: Classification of constituent casework for a Member of the National Assembly of Pakistan. Tier-1 ordering follows complaint volumes reported by the Wafaqi Mohtasib (Federal Ombudsman). Every node carries a jurisdiction, because a Member of the National Assembly has no formal locus on a provincial subject.
metadata.source: Wafaqi Mohtasib (Federal Ombudsman) Annual Report 2024 — 226,372 complaints

data.name: Electricity
data.description: Electricity distribution. Six of the eight most-complained-of bodies in the Wafaqi Mohtasib 2024 report are DISCOs. The distribution companies are federal entities under the Power Division, so an MNA has locus and the Wafaqi Mohtasib has jurisdiction — but electricity itself sits in Part II of the Federal Legislative List under the Council of Common Interests, and Article 157 reserves rights to the provinces.

children.name: Billing and tariff
children.description: The single largest category of electricity complaints.

children.name: Excess or inflated bill
children.description: Bill materially higher than the consumer's usual consumption without a corresponding change in use.

children.name: Detection bill
children.description: Bill raised retrospectively for alleged unrecorded consumption or meter tampering. Frequently disputed and frequently reduced on appeal.

children.name: Estimated or average billing
children.description: Meter not read; bill raised on an average. Common where the meter is inside a locked premises.

children.name: Tariff slab or protected consumer status
children.nameUr: ٹیرف سلیب یا محفوظ صارف کا درجہ
children.description: Consumer wrongly moved out of the protected slab, losing the lower rate.

children.name: Arrears and instalment plan
children.description: Request to spread accumulated arrears over instalments rather than face disconnection.

children.name: New connection delayed
children.description: Demand notice paid but the connection not energised.

children.name: Load extension or reduction
children.description: Sanctioned load does not match actual requirement.

children.name: Agricultural tubewell connection
children.description: Agricultural connections and the agricultural tariff. A large share of rural casework in Punjab and Sindh.

children.name: Load shedding schedule
children.description: Hours of load shedding, including additional hours imposed on high-loss feeders.

children.name: Low voltage or fluctuation
children.description: Voltage too low to run appliances, or fluctuation damaging them.

children.name: Burnt or overloaded transformer
children.description: Replacement or upgrading of a distribution transformer serving the locality.

children.name: Defective or burnt meter
children.description: Replacement of a meter that has stopped, run fast, or burnt out.

children.name: Dangerous poles, wires or installations
children.description: Sagging conductors, leaning poles, or an installation over a residential roof.

children.name: Electrocution or accident compensation
children.nameUr: بجلی کے کرنٹ سے حادثہ یا معاوضہ
children.description: Death or injury from a distribution installation, and the compensation claim that follows.

data.name: Gas
data.description: Natural gas distribution. SNGPL serves Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Islamabad; SSGC serves Sindh and Balochistan. Both are federal entities under the Petroleum Division, though Article 158 gives the province in which a gas well-head is situated precedence in supply.

children.name: Slab and tariff dispute
children.description: Protected-category status and the steep slab structure applied to domestic consumers.

children.name: New domestic connection
children.description: New domestic connections have been restricted for extended periods; confirm the current position with the company before advising the constituent.

children.name: Low pressure
children.description: Winter low pressure, the largest single source of gas casework between November and February.

children.name: Leakage or safety hazard
children.description: A reported leak is an emergency, not ordinary casework — the company's emergency number comes before any written complaint.

children.name: Theft case or detection bill
children.nameUr: چوری کا مقدمہ یا ڈیٹیکشن بل
children.description: Meter removed and a detection bill raised on an allegation of tampering.

children.name: Pakistan Post Office Department
children.description: Ranked ninth by complaint volume in the Wafaqi Mohtasib 2024 report, with 1,031 complaints.

children.name: Lost, delayed or damaged article
children.nameUr: گم شدہ، تاخیر زدہ یا خراب ڈاک
children.description: Ordinary post, registered post and Urgent Mail Service.

children.name: Money order or postal savings
children.nameUr: منی آرڈر یا ڈاک خانہ بچت
children.description: Money orders, Postal Life Insurance and National Savings products sold through post offices.

children.name: Capital Development Authority
children.description: Islamabad Capital Territory only. 557 complaints in 2024. A CDA matter arising anywhere outside Islamabad is misdirected.

children.name: Municipal services in Islamabad
children.description: Water, sanitation and roads within the Capital Territory — federal here, unlike everywhere else in the country.

children.name: Pakistan Railways
children.description: Railways sits in Part II of the Federal Legislative List, so it is administered federally but supervised by the Council of Common Interests.

children.name: Booking, refund or service
children.nameUr: بکنگ، رقم کی واپسی یا سروس

children.name: Telecommunications
children.description: Regulated by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority. Regulatory authorities established under federal law sit in Part II of the Federal Legislative List, entry 6, so PTA, NEPRA and OGRA are all supervised by the Council of Common Interests.
children.ministry: Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication

children.name: SIM blocked or biometric verification
children.nameUr: سم بلاک یا بائیو میٹرک تصدیق
children.description: SIMs blocked on a CNIC mismatch, which usually needs NADRA and the operator resolved together.

children.name: Network or broadband service quality
children.nameUr: نیٹ ورک یا براڈ بینڈ سروس کا معیار

children.name: Nuisance or fraudulent calls and messages
children.nameUr: پریشان کن یا جعلی کالز اور پیغامات

children.name: Federal Investigation Agency
children.description: Federal offences including human trafficking, immigration offences and financial crime. Cybercrime investigation was reorganised in 2024–25 under a separate national agency — confirm the current filing point before advising the constituent.

children.name: Online fraud, harassment or blackmail
children.nameUr: آن لائن فراڈ، ہراسانی یا بلیک میلنگ

children.name: Human trafficking or illegal emigration
children.nameUr: انسانی اسمگلنگ یا غیر قانونی ہجرت
children.description: Includes constituents defrauded by an unlicensed overseas employment promoter.

data.name: Passports and immigration
data.description: Directorate General of Immigration and Passports, an attached department of the Ministry of Interior. 4,692 complaints in 2024.

children.name: Ordinary passport delayed
children.description: Application submitted, fee paid, delivery date passed.

children.name: Urgent or fast-track fee paid but still delayed
children.description: The premium fee creates a service expectation the constituent has paid for.

children.name: Lost, damaged or stolen passport
children.nameUr: گم شدہ، خراب یا چوری شدہ پاسپورٹ

children.name: Name spelling correction
children.description: A mismatch between the passport and the CNIC is the most common cause of a visa refusal.

children.name: Date of birth or other particulars
children.description: Ordinarily requires the NADRA record to be corrected first.

children.name: Exit Control List
children.description: Placement on the ECL is a Ministry of Interior decision. Removal is by review, and this is a matter on which an MNA can properly correspond with the Ministry.

children.name: Passport Control List or blacklist
children.nameUr: پاسپورٹ کنٹرول لسٹ یا بلیک لسٹ
children.description: Distinct from the ECL: it restricts passport issue rather than departure.

children.name: Deportee or Pakistani stranded abroad
children.nameUr: ملک بدر یا بیرونِ ملک پھنسے پاکستانی
children.description: Usually needs the mission abroad as well as the Directorate, so route through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in parallel.

data.name: NADRA — identity and registration
data.description: National Database and Registration Authority, an attached department of the Ministry of Interior. 5,839 complaints in 2024. Almost every other federal service depends on a valid CNIC, so a blocked identity record blocks everything downstream.

children.name: New CNIC or renewal pending
children.nameUr: نیا شناختی کارڈ یا تجدید زیرِ التوا
children.description: Application taken, token issued, card not delivered.

children.name: CNIC blocked or under verification
children.nameUr: شناختی کارڈ بلاک یا زیرِ تصدیق
children.description: Blocking suspends the record and with it a bank account, a SIM, a pension and a BISP payment. Treat as urgent.

children.name: Correction of name, date of birth or parentage
children.nameUr: نام، تاریخِ پیدائش یا والدیت کی درستی

children.name: Family and civil registration
children.description: Routing trap: NADRA does NOT issue birth certificates. The union council or local government issues them, which makes that a PROVINCIAL matter; NADRA only records the registration afterwards.

children.name: Child Registration Certificate (B-Form)
children.description: Required for school admission, a child's passport and inclusion in a BISP household.

children.name: Family Registration Certificate
children.description: The standard proof of family composition for visas, inheritance and benefit claims.

children.name: Death certificate or removal of a deceased record
children.nameUr: وفات کا سرٹیفکیٹ یا مرحوم کا اندراج ختم کرنا

children.name: NICOP
children.description: National Identity Card for Overseas Pakistanis.

children.name: Pakistan Origin Card
children.description: For foreign nationals of Pakistani origin.

data.name: Pensions, labour and workers' welfare
data.nameUr: پنشن، محنت اور مزدوروں کی بہبود

children.name: EOBI
children.description: Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution. 3,583 complaints in 2024. NEEDS LOCAL REVIEW: the parent ministry is stated on the historical position and could not be confirmed from an official source.
children.ministry: Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis and Human Resource Development (needs confirmation)

children.name: Old-age pension claim delayed
children.nameUr: بڑھاپا پنشن کے دعوے میں تاخیر

children.name: Employer not depositing contributions
children.nameUr: آجر کی جانب سے کنٹریبیوشن جمع نہ کرانا
children.description: The commonest cause of a rejected claim: the worker's service is real but the employer never registered or never paid.

children.name: AGPR pension case
children.nameUr: اے جی پی آر پنشن کیس
children.description: Accountant General Pakistan Revenues, within the Controller General of Accounts organisation — federal civil pensions and pay.

children.name: Military pension through the Controller Military Accounts
children.nameUr: کنٹرولر ملٹری اکاؤنٹس کے ذریعے فوجی پنشن
children.description: Controller Military Accounts (Pension), within the Pakistan Military Accounts Department, an attached department of the Ministry of Defence. Federal civil pensions go to AGPR instead; PROVINCIAL government pensions go to the provincial Accountant General and are outside an MNA's locus.

children.name: Family pension after a pensioner's death
children.nameUr: پنشنر کی وفات کے بعد فیملی پنشن

children.name: GP Fund, gratuity or commutation
children.nameUr: جی پی فنڈ، گریجویٹی یا کمیوٹیشن

children.name: Overseas employment and welfare
children.ministry: Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis and Human Resource Development

children.name: Overseas employment promoter or recruitment dispute
children.nameUr: بیرونِ ملک ملازمت کے پروموٹر یا بھرتی کا تنازع
children.description: Licensed promoters are regulated by the Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment.

children.name: BISP
children.description: Benazir Income Support Programme. 20,264 complaints in 2024 — second only to LESCO, and the number reaching a constituency office is higher still, since most beneficiaries go to the MNA before they go to an ombudsman.
children.ministry: Ministry of Poverty Alleviation and Social Safety

children.name: Benazir Kafaalat quarterly stipend
children.description: The unconditional cash stipend, paid quarterly to the woman registered as head of the beneficiary household.

children.name: Benazir NSER survey or PMT score
children.nameUr: بینظیر این ایس ای آر سروے یا پی ایم ٹی سکور
children.description: The official name carries the Benazir prefix: Benazir National Socio-Economic Registry. A household whose circumstances have worsened can seek a re-survey. Eligibility turns on the Proxy Means Test score, and a re-survey is the remedy for a household whose circumstances have worsened.

children.name: Benazir Taleemi Wazaif
children.description: Education stipend conditional on the child's school enrolment and attendance.

children.name: Benazir Nashonuma Programme
children.description: Conditional nutrition support for pregnant and lactating women and children under two.

children.name: Biometric verification failure
children.description: Worn or unreadable fingerprints stop payment at the campsite or agent. It is a NADRA-side problem presenting as a BISP-side one.

children.name: Deduction by a payment agent
children.nameUr: ادائیگی ایجنٹ کی جانب سے کٹوتی
children.description: Illegal deductions by a retailer or branchless-banking agent. The remedy runs through the disbursing bank as well as BISP.

children.name: Wrongly declared ineligible or dropped
children.nameUr: غلط طور پر نااہل قرار یا فہرست سے خارج

children.name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal
children.ministry: Poverty Alleviation and Social Safety Division

children.name: Child support and orphan care
children.nameUr: بچوں کی کفالت اور یتیم بچوں کی دیکھ بھال

data.name: Revenue and taxation
data.description: Federal Board of Revenue. Note the forum: maladministration by FBR goes to the Federal Tax Ombudsman, a separate institution from the Wafaqi Mohtasib with its own statute.

children.name: NTN registration or IRIS access
children.nameUr: این ٹی این رجسٹریشن یا آئی آر آئی ایس تک رسائی

children.name: Active Taxpayer List status
children.nameUr: ایکٹو ٹیکس پیئر لسٹ کی حیثیت
children.description: Absence from the ATL raises withholding rates on banking, property and vehicle transactions.

data.name: Health
data.description: Health service delivery is a provincial subject after the Eighteenth Amendment. What remains federal is regulation, and those national programmes that a province has not taken over.

children.name: Sehat Sahulat / health card
children.description: Now effectively a provincial programme. Verified as operating in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as Sehat Card Plus. NEEDS LOCAL REVIEW: the position in Punjab, Sindh and Balochistan could not be confirmed, and there is no working federal programme website — confirm in the constituent's own province before advising.

children.name: Eligibility or card not issued
children.nameUr: اہلیت یا کارڈ جاری نہ ہونا

children.name: Empanelled hospital refusing treatment
children.nameUr: منظور شدہ ہسپتال کا علاج سے انکار

children.name: Treatment limit or excluded procedure
children.nameUr: علاج کی حد یا خارج شدہ طریقۂ علاج

children.name: Medicine quality, price or availability
children.nameUr: ادویات کا معیار، قیمت یا دستیابی
children.description: Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan.

children.name: Registration of a doctor, nurse or pharmacist
children.nameUr: ڈاکٹر، نرس یا فارماسسٹ کی رجسٹریشن

data.name: Higher education and skills
data.description: Standards in institutions for higher education sit in Part II of the Federal Legislative List, entry 12 — federal competence, but supervised by the Council of Common Interests rather than exclusively federal. Administratively the HEC is a federal body and the Wafaqi Mohtasib takes complaints against it. School education is provincial and appears under provincial subjects; Punjab and Sindh also run their own provincial higher education commissions.

children.name: Degree attestation
children.description: Required for overseas employment and further study; a bottleneck for constituents with a job offer and a deadline.

children.name: Recognition of a university or programme
Training place or certification
children.description: National Vocational and Technical Training Commission and its provincial counterparts.

data.name: Provincial subjects
data.description: Subjects that fell to the provinces when the Concurrent Legislative List was abolished by the Eighteenth Amendment in 2010. A Member of the NATIONAL Assembly has no formal locus on any of them. These cases still walk into the constituency office every day, so they are classified here and routed onward — to the MPA, or to the provincial ombudsman. The Wafaqi Mohtasib cannot take them.

children.name: Police and criminal process
children.description: The police force is provincial. Two exceptions worth knowing: Islamabad Capital Territory Police is FEDERAL, under the Ministry of Interior, and the FIA handles federal offences. Note also that criminal law and criminal procedure are a concurrent field under Article 142(b) even though the force that applies them is provincial.

children.name: FIR not registered
children.description: Registration under section 154 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is compelled through the Justice of the Peace under section 22-A, not through a Member of the National Assembly. In Islamabad the police are federal, so an ICT case is the one exception where an MNA does have a route.

children.name: Police misconduct or unlawful detention
children.nameUr: پولیس کی بدسلوکی یا غیر قانونی حراست

children.name: Land record or fard
children.description: Computerised through the provincial land records authorities; the service centre, not the patwari, is the point of contact.

children.name: Teacher absence or shortage
children.nameUr: استاد کی غیر حاضری یا کمی

children.name: Water supply and sanitation
children.description: Outside the Islamabad Capital Territory, water and sanitation are municipal and therefore provincial.

children.name: Basic Health Unit or Rural Health Centre
children.nameUr: بنیادی مرکزِ صحت یا دیہی مرکزِ صحت

children.name: District or tehsil headquarters hospital
children.nameUr: ضلعی یا تحصیل ہیڈ کوارٹر ہسپتال
